text: Argentina's peso collapsed 3x in 5 years. Their central bank printed 180% of GDP to prevent it. Bitcoin's supply is fixed forever. One is a policy choice. The other isn't

In 1971 Nixon closed the gold window because he couldn't defend $35 per ounce anymore. Today governments can't defend their currencies either. Iran knows this. That's why they're collecting tolls in the only asset they can't print
1923 Reichsbank printed 1.2 billion marks in one day. People burned currency for warmth. Today's central banks print digitally so you can't see the ash. Bitcoin doesn't print at all
In 1944 Bretton Woods fixed gold at $35 an ounce. Governments promised to honor it. By 1971 Nixon closed the window. Bitcoin doesn't need promises. It has math

1923 Reichsbank printed 1.2 billion marks in one day. People burned currency for heat. 2026 Fed balance sheet at $7.3 trillion. Nobody's burning dollars yet. The denominator always matters more than the numerator
Morgan Stanley's ETF launches while 1 sat/vB fees persist. Institutions pay to enter Bitcoin. Users pay nothing to transact on it. One of these groups understands what they're buying
How many people know their bank can legally freeze their account for 10 business days without explanation. Bitcoin doesn't have that problem

MicroStrategy bought 4 days worth of new Bitcoin supply. Morgan Stanley bought it on day one. Meanwhile retail is trading on a 14 fear index. Smart money doesn't wait for permission or confidence. It waits for price
Strategy bought 546 BTC in 90 minutes. That's 1.2x daily mining supply absorbed by one buyer. When institutions stack faster than the network produces, what's the actual price discovery mechanism
88% of private credit redemption requests got denied last quarter. When $13.9B in withdrawals hit a wall, which asset doesn't need permission to move
Exchange deposits at 10-year lows while fear is 16. People aren't selling into panic. They're treating scarcity like it's already priced in
Do you know what happens to your savings when 88% of people trying to withdraw their money get told no
Prague 1989 defied Soviet control. Prague 2026 defies EU payment bans. Bitcoin doesn't need permission from dying empires
